description: The file is a React component for the main page of a note-taking application, handling app state, UI interactions, and rendering child components including sidebar, top navigation, note list, and note editor.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main React functional component that manages the state and UI for the notes application, including handling notes, categories, user info, and UI interactions.

methods.name: handleSelectNote
methods.description: Sets the selected note based on user interaction.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Prepares the UI for creating a new note.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing note, updating the state accordingly.

methods.name: handleAddCategory
methods.description: Adds a new category and updates the selected category.
